contract.fallback: No idle capital allocation is modeled; rows represent detected cross-venue paper entries only.
contract.selectionPolicy: Current cross-venue candidates are paper scans only. SPX/SPY threshold-curve rows are selected by net convergence edge after fee and basis haircuts; low-liquidity, restricted, or loose comparable-market rows remain watchlist-only and do not count in selected returns.
contract.signalTiming: Use current venue top-of-book quotes only. The paper pair is buy cheap YES and buy rich NO, then exit when the gap compresses, reverses, basis worsens, or the market closes.
contract.overfitControl: No contract wording is auto-promoted and no historical fill edge is promoted. The selected artifact excludes restricted/low-liquidity comparable rows and every pair remains subject to same-underlier, source, fee, liquidity, rule-text, restriction, and venue-basis review before any paper or live execution.

selected.sourceSetLabel: Kalshi public market data + Polymarket Gamma/CLOB metadata

realityCheck.comparison: Kalshi/Polymarket SPX/SPY threshold-curve top-of-book relative-value rows
realityCheck.alternative: No historical fill edge promoted; low-liquidity/restricted comparable rows are watchlist-only
realityCheck.limitation: This is a current paper scan, not a historical fill backtest. Basis, rule text, source, orderbook depth, and venue restrictions must be reviewed before execution.

caveat: This is a research and paper-candidate artifact, not live routing. Current cross-venue rows are not a historical fill backtest; only SPX/SPY threshold-curve rows are selected, while loose comparable or low-liquidity rows stay watchlist-only until rule text and venue-basis are reviewed.
